exposure: 3 diet adherence indices (macronutritional (MDI), phytochemical (PDI), and energetic (EDI))
outcome: diet quality indicators (Fat Quality Index, Minimum Dietary Diversity for Women, Healthy Plant-Based Diet Index)
milk biomarkers (protein-to-carbohydrate ratio, protein, superoxide anion)
intakes of calcium, fiber, and energy
cohort: The study participants were 284 lactating women.
finding: The study successfully developed and validated three reliable diet adherence indices (MDI, PDI, EDI) that correlated positively with diet quality and milk biomarkers, allowing for prompt assessment of diet to diagnose maternal malnutrition.
